purpose: Canonical visual source for Tier0 presentation layouts. Read this catalog together with the live Layout Gallery before adapting another deck.

canvas.blockGap: 40px minimum unless a registered layout specifies a denser rhythm

layouts.useWhen: Start a customer or product narrative with one category statement.
layouts.visualRule: White editorial field; bracket one keyword and reserve green for the adjacent signal field.
layouts.avoid: Do not turn this into a full-green cover or add a feature grid.

layouts.useWhen: Introduce sections, chapters, or a guided discussion.
layouts.visualRule: Use oversized sequence numbers and six-or-fewer destinations; preserve the open field.
layouts.avoid: Do not use as a generic content page or stack cards inside it.

layouts.useWhen: Show an evolution, maturity path, or measured before-to-after progression.
layouts.visualRule: One vertical chronology plus a single active end state and supporting KPI row.
layouts.avoid: Do not use when the sequence is not temporal or the figures are not sourced.

layouts.useWhen: Land one decisive claim, section transition, or memorable framing statement.
layouts.visualRule: Ink half holds the thesis; neutral half gives only a short proof or clarification.
layouts.avoid: Do not put two competing headlines or dense feature lists on either half.

layouts.useWhen: Explain six capabilities, dimensions, or recurring concepts at equal weight.
layouts.visualRule: Keep the 2×3 field uniform; use labels and short descriptions, not mini dashboards.
layouts.avoid: Do not force fewer or more than six concepts into this structure.

layouts.useWhen: Explain a three-level architecture, operating model, or value stack.
layouts.visualRule: Read top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top; one layer can receive the green focus treatment.
layouts.avoid: Do not use for a chronological process or an unstructured list.

layouts.useWhen: Make one business measure feel consequential while retaining a small amount of context.
layouts.visualRule: One dominant number; every supporting measure must explain the same outcome.
layouts.avoid: Do not add decorative statistics or mix unrelated metrics.

layouts.useWhen: Compare alternatives, adoption states, or a small ranked set of real values.
layouts.visualRule: Neutral bars carry context; green identifies only the decision-driving focus value.
layouts.avoid: Do not use with unsourced values or more than one green winner.

layouts.useWhen: Contrast current versus future, isolated versus connected, or two operating choices.
layouts.visualRule: Mirror both sides on the same axis and reserve contrast for the conclusion, not decoration.
layouts.avoid: Do not use for three-or-more options or unpaired information.

layouts.useWhen: Create a pause before a new idea, method, or point of view.
layouts.visualRule: One idea, ample whitespace, and a restrained dot matrix as environmental texture.
layouts.avoid: Do not place body copy, metrics, or multiple modules over the matrix.

layouts.useWhen: Introduce a major chapter, change the narrative gear, or give a single thesis room before detailed content begins.
layouts.visualRule: Use a deep ink field, one oversized left-aligned title, and only a restrained chapter label plus a small footer.
layouts.avoid: Do not add a right-side takeaway list, CTA grid, decorative illustration, or a second headline.

layouts.useWhen: Show four to five ordered handoffs with the three capabilities that make the flow repeatable.
layouts.visualRule: Use the upper field for three short enabling forces, then let one horizontal spine carry the ordered steps.
layouts.avoid: Do not invent KPI numbers or turn this into a cyclical loop.

layouts.useWhen: Summarize a positioning argument in three co-dependent pillars.
layouts.visualRule: Use full-width columns, large sequence numbers at the base, and one restrained signal emphasis.
layouts.avoid: Do not turn pillars into cards or place the proof line too close to the columns.

layouts.useWhen: Show how on-site sources connect through a Tier0 site or namespace to cloud-scale applications and models.
layouts.visualRule: Use two equal system zones, one clear central core per zone, and one single directional bridge. Keep labels in HTML and connectors geometric.
layouts.avoid: Do not use a point-to-point mesh, duplicate the core, or put unlabeled crossings inside the board.
layouts.primaryEvidence: On-site system boundary + cloud system boundary + one governed bridge

layouts.useWhen: Explain an iterative learning, governance, or improvement cycle.
layouts.visualRule: Keep dashed and directional rings spatially separate; nodes sit on the shared axes and the center remains unfilled.
layouts.avoid: Do not add decorative icons, overlapping arrows, or vague relationship labels.

layouts.useWhen: Show 2–4 related images with short captions: product states, site evidence, process steps, or case-study proof.
layouts.visualRule: Use one primary image and 1–3 supporting images in a shared rectangular grid; keep image treatment and captions consistent.
layouts.avoid: Do not mix image ratios, make a decorative collage, or use generic stock imagery without an evidentiary role.

layouts.useWhen: Show one product task through a video, a live web prototype, or one controlled UI state.
layouts.visualRule: Left side explains what to watch; the right side is a 16:9 rectangular player frame with a single task and a visible final state.
layouts.avoid: Do not embed a generic dashboard, multiple product flows, autoplay audio, or a rounded video card.
layouts.primaryEvidence: Video, real product recording, or bounded web prototype

layouts.useWhen: Pair a business statement with a compact relationship diagram or technical system model.
layouts.visualRule: Left side explains the value; the right half is full-bleed neutral surface containing the diagram only.
layouts.avoid: Do not put a white filled center behind the system label or crowd the diagram with iconography.

layouts.useWhen: Explain three durable business outcomes with concise operational proof and one readable metric per argument.
layouts.visualRule: Bring the title high; three equal pale-green argument columns use one summary, two proof points, and an aligned outcome band.
layouts.avoid: Do not use permanent active cards, oversized icons, bold display numerals, or uneven metric footers.
layouts.primaryEvidence: Three outcomes + concise proof + outcome metric

layouts.useWhen: Explain four linked platform benefits with one clear visual metaphor each.
layouts.visualRule: Use a dense 20px four-column rhythm and one simple black/green line illustration per module; alternate neutral and pale-green surfaces.
layouts.avoid: Do not use complex architecture illustrations, excessive card gaps, repeated stock-style icons, or a decorative top signal bar.

layouts.useWhen: List a concise set of operational measures, commercial facts, or named commitments.
layouts.visualRule: Use horizontal rows, consistent labels, and a single signal marker for the active record.
layouts.avoid: Do not turn it into a dashboard or use invented performance numbers.

layouts.useWhen: Choose a chart grammar according to the decision: rank, change, contribution, or composition.
layouts.visualRule: Use one reading task per figure; black and grey carry context, green signals only the focal value or state.
layouts.avoid: Do not decorate data with arbitrary icons, rainbow palettes, or several green winners.

layouts.useWhen: Show one real product scene, customer evidence image, or controlled product demo with three measures.
layouts.visualRule: Keep the 21:9 image as evidence, title block on white, and lower KPI strip aligned to the main grid.
layouts.avoid: Do not use a generic fake dashboard, rounded screenshot shell, or a decorative background image.

layouts.useWhen: Use for source-faithful routing logic, configuration, API payloads, workflow rules, or a long technical text block.
layouts.visualRule: Keep literal tokens, indentation and sequence in a large readable code field; use the left rail only for source context and how to read it.
layouts.avoid: Do not shrink technical content into caption text, invent syntax, turn it into decorative cards, or use green as ordinary white-background text.

layouts.useWhen: Choose a relationship grammar before generating or drawing a system diagram: namespace hub, linear flow, layered tree, or a point-to-point anti-pattern comparison.
layouts.visualRule: Use a small number of named systems, one clear relationship type, 1px connectors, and a single green core or active path. Labels live in HTML, never inside the SVG.
layouts.avoid: Do not combine hub, tree, and mesh relationships in one diagram; do not use noisy shadows, decorative icons, or unlabeled crossing connectors.

layouts.useWhen: End a deck with a declarative conclusion and three concise takeaways.
layouts.visualRule: Ink left field closes emotionally; white right field makes three practical takeaways, with only the final row signaled.
layouts.avoid: Do not add a second CTA, contact grid, or extra visual motif.
